items.title: 定稿 global-thin 管理资产契约
items.context: Define canonical new-project assets under .Lattice plus thin AGENTS.md, legacy compatibility paths, and explicit full/local-shim modes. Related docs: docs/requirements/decisions/lifecycle-artifact-scope.md, docs/requirements/decisions/stack-layering.md, README.md.

items.title: 修改 init 默认输出为 .Lattice 最小资产
items.context: Fresh lattice init must create .Lattice/Lattice.md, .Lattice/lattice.json, thin AGENTS.md, and must not create bin/lattice*.js, .Codex/README.md, .Codex/lattice.json, .Codex/agents, or KOALA.md by default.

items.title: 把 Codex verify/doctor 能力收回全局 CLI
items.context: Expose global commands such as lattice codex verify and lattice codex doctor, make legacy local shims proxy/fallback, and ensure resolver prefers .Lattice/lattice.json before .Codex or KOALA-era paths.

items.title: 实现非破坏迁移与 legacy compatibility
items.context: lattice check should advise/apply canonical .Lattice assets without deleting legacy files by default; prune legacy assets only behind an explicit option. Existing KOALA.md, .Codex/koala.json, bin/koala-codex.js, and bin/lattice-codex.js must keep working.

items.title: 补 smoke/contract 验证并重新 build
items.context: Add tests for fresh minimal init, no local shim by default, .Lattice resolver, global codex verify/doctor, legacy compatibility, and non-destructive check/apply migration. Finish with npm --prefix packages/main run build and targeted smokes.
items.userSees: 用户看到 build 和 smoke 结果明确证明：新项目文件树干净、全局 lattice codex 命令可用、旧 Koala/Lattice shim 项目仍兼容，且全局 lattice 重新 build 后使用最新 dist。

happy.desc: npm --prefix packages/main run build 通过，targeted smoke 全部通过。

edge.desc: 测试同时覆盖 fresh minimal 项目和 legacy Koala 项目，不只覆盖其中一种。

adversarial.desc: 若测试只检查文件存在、不检查默认不生成 forbidden assets，或者全局命令未真实执行，则验收失败。
